events.title: Seeking Vendor Applications
events.description:
The TR Site is proud to announce its inaugural “Sleigh Shop at the Carriage House” — sponsored by Wegmans.

This two-day artisan market will take place on Small Business Saturday (Sat, Nov 28) and continue through Sunday, November 29th. It will be open from 10:00am to 5:00pm each day.

Artisans/vendors who are interested in participating are invited to fill out an application.

Note that applications must be submitted no later than November 5th to be included in promotional marketing. We are unable to guarantee that artisans/vendors who submit applications after that date will be acknowledged in marketing materials.

Please return application & payment to:

TR Inaugural Site

Attn: Genna Munoz-Mages

641 Delaware Ave

Buffalo, NY 14202

events.title: Early Voting
events.description:
The TR Site is proud to partner with the Erie County Board of Elections to serve as an Early Voting Site for the 2026 General Election.

Any registered Erie County (NY) voter — regardless of where they live — can vote early at the TR Site. Questions about voter eligibility should be directed to the Erie Co. Board of Elections (716) 858-8891.

The TR Site will also host a dedicated and colorful voting booth as part of the Kids Voting USA initiative, a nonpartisan voter education program committed to creating lifelong voting habits in children.

**PLEASE NOTE** Early Voting Hours are as follows:

Saturday, October 24th thru Sunday, November 1st

Weekdays (Mon -Fri) | 12 Noon – 9:00 pm

Weekends (Sat & Sun) | 9:00 am – 5:00 pm
events.cost_note: Must be a registered voter in Erie Co, NY
